rule.statement: The court may allow substitution of a party in a case where the deceased party had named an executor in their will, without requiring the executor to be registered or the board of directors to have sanctioned the transfer of shares.
rule.supporting_quote: It is by operation of law and a right in law that substitution need to be permitted in a case of this nature.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 232 of the Companies Act No. 7 of 2007.
